title: Demat 2.0 will bring instant bond settlement closer, trading after regulation and market readiness: NSDL MD
summary: Demat 2.0 can allow investors to receive tokenised bonds instantly against payments made through the central bank digital currency (CBDC), significantly reducing the time gap in securities settlement, NSDL Managing Director Vijay Chandok said, while noting that wider trading will depend on regulatory approval and market readiness.

title: India-EU FTA: EU gets tariff quota for 1 lakh cars initially, rising to 1.6 lakh
summary: The India-EU free trade agreement will allow European automakers to export 1 lakh passenger vehicles annually at concessional duties initially, rising to 1.6 lakh from the 10th year. The pact also offers tariff concessions on electric vehicles, wines, pork, apples, kiwifruit, pears and peaches through quotas and price-based conditions.

title: SEBI to issue consultation paper on derivatives settlement price methodology on Saturday
summary: The Securities and Exchange Board of India will issue a consultation paper to refine settlement price methodology for derivative contracts. Following the Closing Auction Session’s impact, SEBI seeks to improve market practices.&nbsp;

title: FII index futures shorts hit 5-month high, bearish positioning raises odds of sharp market move
summary: On September 10, FIIs held 3,21,538 short index futures contracts, against 39,694 long contracts, taking the long-short ratio to around 11%, a historically low level

title: Granules India promoter sells 1.72 crore shares worth Rs 1,500 crore; Goldman Sachs, BNP Paribas among investors
summary: Granules India promoter Krishna Prasad Chigurupati sold 1.72 crore shares worth about Rs 1,500 crore through block and open-market deals. The sale funds the second tranche of a preferential issue, while promoter holding falls to 31.08% following the transaction today.

title: Peru awaits India response as trade talks near end, minister says
summary: Peru sent a counterproposal to India for a free trade agreement.  This deal is hoped to be signed by the year 2027.  India has become Peru's second-largest export destination this year.  Peru also discussed recent United States duties on its exports.  Discussions continue regarding tariffs and bilateral trade relations with Washington.

title: Up 725% in five years: Small-cap stock to be in focus on Monday after  ₹5.12 crore order win
